_comment: Open-source river/streamflow projects surveyed for River Flow Israel. Kept as a registry rather than as vendored code: scripts/fetch-reference-projects.sh re-clones any of them on demand. 'integration' is a licence verdict, not a technical one - read docs/PROJECT_REGISTRY.md before reusing anything.

projects.what: River water-level monitor: 124 gauges on 23 rivers, map plus per-station history charts, hourly ingestion
national_feeds: https://www.vizugy.hu (OVF, General Directorate of Water Management)
hydroinfo.hu (on their roadmap, not yet used)
projects.integration_note: No licence file in the repository, which means all rights reserved. Study freely, copy nothing.
take: 24h trend with a dead band and a null state
official flood-alert thresholds as colour bands

projects.what: 3D geospatial hazard platform: real-time flood, rainfall, dam and earthquake monitoring by province
take: a national feed catalogue for Thailand
dam state as a first-class layer

projects.what: Flood viewer over USGS and NWS gauges with SMS subscription. Archived read-only, September 2024
projects.integration_note: MIT, but archived and depends on a commercial weather key.
take: NOAA AHPS as a forecast source
alert subscription as a product idea

projects.what: Animates the path of a raindrop downstream to the sea
projects.integration_note: GPL-3.0, which can legally be combined with this project's AGPL-3.0. Marked ideas-only by choice, not by licence: it is unusable as shipped without two Mapbox tokens, which breaks the no-keys rule. The valuable part is the NLDI endpoint, not the code.
take: MERIT Hydro as a global network with connectivity

projects.what: Sentinel-1 flood extent by the Bayesian decision method of Bauer-Marschallinger et al. (2022)
national_feeds: https://stac.eodc.eu/api/v1 (European Open Data Centre STAC - no NASA Earthdata login)
projects.integration_note: MIT, pip-installable, and the only keyless route to observed water extent found in this survey.
take: observed surface water for reservoirs, lakes and large floods, baked offline into data/

projects.what: Official USGS cartogram of streamflow percentile against the historic record
national_feeds: USGS internal pipeline (USGS-VIZLAB/gage-conditions-gif); not directly callable
projects.integration_note: Depends on a USGS-internal pipelining package. The framing is the value, not the code.
take: 'flow percentile relative to the historic record' as the standard way to express flow vs normal

projects.what: Upload a project boundary, get every USGS gauge within and around it
projects.integration_note: Custom licence text in the README; read it before reusing.
take: USGS NWIS site service for gauge discovery

projects.what: Interactive dashboard of Bavarian river water levels
projects.integration_note: Repository exists but the clone timed out twice; nothing here has been verified.

projects.what: Flood Python Toolbox, SAR-based flood mapping
projects.integration_note: Found in search, not cloned or examined.
